tasks.title: Remember the added repositories
tasks.body:
When a repository is added, i want a new project created in github of this repo under issues/projects. This will be pulled on startup again. 
All the tasks on the kanban boards here, will be saved here

tasks.title: Should be able to go back to moving
tasks.body: After pressing escape or interacting with the board or a worker, after closing this out again, i should be able to go back to moving around again
